meta.title: POKIZA — Quality You Can Trust
meta.description: POKIZA — heritage, quality, and a modern approach to poultry production since 1992.

hero.description: At POKIZA, we bring together decades of experience, responsible production, and a commitment to improving every day.
hero.imageAlt: Poultry on a farm — a glimpse into modern poultry farming

intro.label: GET TO KNOW POKIZA
intro.heading: Rooted in experience.
intro.body: Since 1992, POKIZA has stood for resilience, attention to detail, and pride in our work. We value people's trust and work every day to earn it.

values.label: OUR APPROACH
values.heading: Principles behind
values.subtitle: Trust is built through everyday actions — from our processes to the way we treat people.
values.oneBody: Care at every stage of our work and thoughtful decision-making.
values.twoBody: Continuous process improvement and attention to detail.
values.threeBody: Respect for our team, professional development, and moving forward together.

feature.title: Strong roots. New opportunities.
feature.body: We preserve what time has proven and embrace new ways of working that help us improve.

careers.label: CAREERS AT POKIZA
careers.title: Grow with us.
careers.body: People are behind every achievement. We value initiative, responsibility, and the drive to grow. Interested in joining our team? Get in touch to learn about current opportunities.

contact.label: LET'S CONNECT
contact.title: Start a conversation.
contact.body: Interested in partnership opportunities, have a question, or want to work at POKIZA? Choose your preferred way to reach us.
contact.note: Official contact details and social profiles will be added once confirmed by the company.

footer.privacy: Information on this website is provided for general reference.
